title: Fixed-error and standard BPP coincide
statement: For every language $L$ of bit strings, $L$ has a polynomial-time verifier whose probability of the correct answer on inputs of length $n$ is at least $2/3$ if and only if it has a polynomial-time verifier whose probability of the correct answer is at least $2/3$ on every input.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ is a language of bit strings
